title: Tumor gasdermin E acts as a rheostat to limit apoptotic cell survival and mutagenesis in anticancer immune environments.
snippet: Recent studies have described an ability of cancer cells to survive engagement of apoptotic pathways following chemical and therapeutic insults, challenging the prevailing model that caspase activation inevitably leads to cellular demise.
